notes.title: v0.1.1.0 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're excited to bring you our first patch with fixes and improvements. Here's what we’ve addressed so far:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized materials for better performance.
[*] Fixed lobby bugs where lobbies became inaccessible after re-creating.
[*] Improved resolution settings to avoid scaling issues and alt-tab glitches.
[*] Resolved collision issues causing the farmer to get stuck in specific areas.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam names missing or incorrect in the lobby.
[*] WASD controls not functioning for clients.
[*] Occasional freezing on the animal selection screen.
[/list]

[b]Stay Connected:[/b]
Roadmap: Follow our [url=https://trello.com/b/iCc0HrQg/farm-wars-roadmap]Trello Roadmap[/url] to track progress and see what’s coming next.
Feedback Form: Share your thoughts and suggestions through our [url=https://forms.gle/FhJEb8vECkhWTtWHA]Feedback Form[/url]

Thank you for your support and feedback! 🐓

notes.title: 🎉 Farm Wars is Now Live on Steam Early Access! 🌾
notes.notes:
The day has finally arrived! After two years of passion, dedication, and countless hours of hard work, Farm Wars is officially available on Steam Early Access—and it’s completely free to play.

What is Farm Wars?
Farm Wars combines farming, strategy, and PvP action in a fast-paced and chaotic environment. Grow crops, defend your farm, and transform into powerful animals to raid your rivals. Every match is a test of wits and tactics, offering a unique and exciting experience.

What’s Next?
Our roadmap includes exciting additions like:
[list]
[*] Achievements
[*] Co-op Mode
[*] New crops and animals
[*] Customization options
[*] Ranking system and leaderboards
[*] Chat system and quick match
[/list]
You can follow our development journey here: [url=https://trello.com/b/iCc0HrQg/farm-wars-roadmap]Trello Roadmap[/url]

💬 How You Can Help:

Play the game and share your thoughts!
Leave a review on Steam—your feedback makes a huge difference.
Report bugs or suggest ideas through our Feedback Form.
This is just the beginning of the Farm Wars journey. Thank you for being part of it—we can’t wait to see how far we’ll go together! 🐓

notes.title: 🌾 Our Big Reveal is Finally Here! 🎮
notes.notes:
We’ve been holding back, but now it’s time for the BIG REVEAL! Farm Wars is launching on [b]January 10, 2025[/b], and the best part—it’s [b]FREE TO PLAY![/b] 🚜✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2094930/Farm_Wars/

This isn’t just a game; it’s where strategy meets competition. With [b]7 language[/b] options, including English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, and [b]more[/b], we’re building a global community ready to farm, raid, and dominate. 🌍

Mark your calendars, [b]wishlist [/b]on Steam, and join the hype! Let’s make this launch unforgettable.
